limits: model is the model ORDERED at launch; the runtime exposes no effective-model record
tokens are runtime-reported subagent tokens from receipts; orchestrator context is not counted
quality findings (lapses, checker findings, refusal reasons) are in orchestration_learning_log.v1.jsonl, not here
books whose executions predate per-attempt receipts are absent or partial

amending rows (completion, amendment, recovery note) are folded into the execution they name and are not executions (the shared fold, campaign/_receipt_fold.py); tokens_total is the runtime notification unit (OW-28), from tokens_reported or a landing row's tokens_notification_unit; spend_unit_amended_total is the spend unit (transcript-measured input + cache_creation + output, or a landing row's tokens_spend_unit) and is never added to it (E-55, E-60)
tokens_partial_executions counts executions whose notification covers one segment only
